use.title: Match them up: more, fewer, or the same
use.differs: K-012 pairs two rows with lines, but the page is ONE task with two EQUAL rows of 4-6 and asks for no decision; the need has six tasks, unequal rows of 1-10, and "circle the row with pictures left over / color the same star". K-008/K-009 ask more/fewer but without the pairing lines. Not a small change: a new mode (several unequal row pairs plus the more / fewer / same mark).
use.note: built: two rows to pair column by column, circle the row with more or color the star (Match Them Up)

use.title: One more, one less
use.differs: K-443 (counting-more, mode one-more) shows rows of pictures and asks ONE direction per task (draw one more, or cross one out) and one answer box; the need shows a ten-frame with 2-9 counters and three boxes (one less, how many, one more). G1-131 level 1 has the three-box row within 10 but prints the middle number, nothing to count. Small change: a new mode that puts a ten-frame over the three boxes.
use.note: one direction a task, with pictures; level 3 mixes one more and one less

use.title: Which number is greater?
use.differs: K-606 level 1 (glyph-tasks, mode bigger): six pairs of written numbers 1-10, never equal, color the greater. Missing: the number line 1-10 on top and the last part "circle the number that is less"; six pairs, not twelve. Small change (a "less" option and a number-line strip). K-460 level 1 prints counting dots under the numbers and has an equal pair, so it fits less.
use.note: six pairs of written numbers; the number line on top is on the projector tool

use.title: Draw the shape
use.differs: K-372 (the type behind point K:draw-shapes) is the dot-paper page: four cards (triangle, square, square, rectangle), read the name, join the dots. Missing: the two boxes "how many sides / how many corners". Small change (two write-in boxes per card).
use.note: the dot-paper page; sides and corners are counted aloud

use.title: Write the numbers 10 to 20
use.differs: K-253 is one tracing lane for each number 11-20 (level 3: model, trace, start dot only, two empty). Missing: the number 10, the small picture of two ten-frames in front of each lane, and the last row to write 10-20 in order. Small change to the same lane page.
use.note: tracing lanes for 11 to 20

use.title: Count and write how many: up to 20
use.differs: Count and Write (K-006) stops at 15 (level 3: 8-15) and SCATTERS the pictures, which the need forbids. K-027 level 3 gives 12, 15, 16 or 20 pictures in even rows of 4-5 with a write-in box, but only those four numbers and no line or circle layout. Small change: a level of K-006 with 11-20 pictures laid in a line, rows of five or a ring.
use.note: built: 11 to 20 pictures in rows of five, any number (Count and Write: 11 to 20)

use.title: Count on from a number
use.differs: K-444 (counting-more, mode count-on) is this task: a closed box with its number, loose pictures beside it, write the total. Range differs: box 3-8, loose 1-5, and the total is capped at 10 (need: bag 3-9, total up to 14); four tasks, not eight. Small change (raise the cap in the level table).
use.note: the same task with totals to 10

use.title: Take away: how many are left?
use.differs: K-451 (frame-more, mode frame-minus) shows a ten-frame with 3-10 counters, but the taken-away counters are ALREADY crossed out (1-3 of them) and the sentence is "7 − 2 = □"; the need prints "Take away 3.", the child crosses out, and completes "_ are left". Small change: an option that leaves the counters uncrossed and prints the sentence.
use.note: counters crossed out on the ten-frame

use.title: Some more come: adding stories
use.differs: G1-238 level 1 / G1-240: add-to stories within 10 with the picture of both groups and ONE answer box, two stories a page. Missing: the empty ten-frame to draw in and the frame _ + _ = _ for all three numbers. G1-444 has the full number sentence but from a picture with no story. Medium change: the story engine needs an equation frame and a ten-frame panel.
use.note: add-to stories with a picture and one answer box (Kindergarten solves with drawings)

use.title: Some go away: take-away stories
use.differs: G1-239 level 1: take-away stories within 10; the pictures are printed with the taken ones already crossed out and the child writes only the answer. Missing: a ten-frame with the start number as circles for the child to cross out, and the frame _ - _ = _. G1-444 level 2 has the full sentence from a crossed-out picture, no story. Medium change, the same one as K-012.
use.note: take-away stories with a picture

use.title: Take apart 6 and 7
use.differs: K-454 level 3 (frame-more, mode colour-parts) is the same act: color a frame in two colors a different way each time and write □ + □ = 10, but only for the whole 10 (level 1: whole 5); no 6 or 7, a ten-frame instead of a cube train, and the equation is not in the form 6 = _ + _. K-456 number houses split 6 and 7 every way but only ask for the missing part. Small change: wholes 6 and 7 in the colour-parts table and the total-first equation.
use.note: built: a strip of 6 or 7 squares coloured in two colours; level 2 finds five ways to make 6, level 3 six ways to make 7 (Take Apart 6 and 7)

use.title: Take apart 8 and 9
use.differs: Number Bonds Within 10 (K-274) mixes wholes 5-10. K-416 (bonds of 8) and K-417 (bonds of 9) fix the whole; their level 1 shows counting dots in the printed part and a dashed circle for the missing part. Missing: the equation 8 = _ + _ under each bond, and 8 and 9 on one page (today two pages). Small change (an equation line; wholes [8, 9] in one config).
use.note: the bond pages of 8 and of 9

use.title: Partners of 10
use.differs: G1-106 has the same equation (6 + □ = 10) for 1-9, but over a ten-frame, not a bead string. K-449 level 1 draws the row of ten beads with some pushed left but asks only "how many beads". No page joins the bead string with the missing-partner equation, and none has equation-only rows. Small change: a frame-more mode that puts the rekenrek row over the make-10 equation.
use.note: the same equation on a ten-frame

use.title: Ten and some more
use.differs: G2-206 (base-ten-tasks, mode regroup; a Grade 2 page) is the same act: 11-19 loose unit cubes, ring ten, write "□ ten + □ ones". Differs: unit cubes, not straws or crayons in rows of five; 11-19 is split over levels (11-13, 13-19, 16-19); the frame uses "×10" and has no box for the whole number. Small change (a Kindergarten level 11-19 with "10 and _" and the number).
use.note: built: circle ten of 11 to 19 things, then 10 + _ = _ (Ten and Some More)

use.title: Build and draw a teen number
use.differs: K-448 is the reverse direction: the two frames are filled and the child writes the number. Needed: the number is printed, the two frames are EMPTY, the child draws, then completes 15 = 10 + _. K-452 level 3 has rows where a number 11-20 is given and the child draws it on two frames, but mixed with tally rows and with no equation. Small change: a draw mode of the same double-frame factory.
use.note: built: the number is printed, the child draws it into two empty ten-frames (Draw the Number on Two Ten-Frames)

use.title: Ten and how many more?
use.differs: No bond page has a teen number as the whole with 10 as one part: K-275 fixes the whole at 20, K-276 hides the whole. The bond factory can do it by config (wholes 11-19, given part 10). Missing as well: the equation 10 + _ = 17 under each bond (K-448 has "□ = 10 + □" beside two ten-frames instead) and the whole bottom half ("10 and 4": circle 14 or 41). Medium change.
use.note: built: number bonds with a teen number as the whole and ten as one part (Ten and How Many More?)

use.title: Count to 50
use.differs: G1-129 is the same task (write the missing numbers on a number chart) but always on the full chart 1-100 with 8, 12 or 20 blanks placed at random. Needed: a chart 1-50 with fourteen blanks around each new ten. The chart primitive takes start and end, so it is a small change: a level with end 50 and the blanks near the tens.
use.note: built: the number chart 1 to 50 with ten empty boxes (level 3: fourteen, in runs)

use.title: Start at any number and count on
use.differs: K-020 is the same strip task (count along, write the missing numbers) but only within 20, with ten boxes and 2-4 blanks. Needed: six tracks of five boxes, only the first number given, start numbers up to 67, three tracks crossing a ten. The strip factory already takes start "any", startMax and rangeMax, so it is a small change (a new face: step 1, range to 100, four blanks after the first box). G1-437 is skip counting, not counting by ones.
use.note: built: number strips that start anywhere, to 50 on level 1 and to 100 from level 2 (Count On from Any Number)

use.title: Count by tens to 100
use.differs: Two existing pages cover the two halves. G1-123 is the bottom half (a strip of tens to 100 with missing numbers). G1-126 level 1 is close to the top half: groups of ten pictures with a running total to WRITE, where the need shows cups marked 10 and three numbers to circle. No single page has both. Small change.
use.note: the strip of tens to 100, with the groups-of-ten page

use.title: True or false?
use.differs: G1-443 (addsub-more, mode truefalse) is this page: twelve equations, tick true or false, usual form, total first (8 = 5 + 3) and both sides (9 − 2 = 3 + 4). Differs: the levels with the three forms run within 20, not 10 (only level 1 is within 10 and has the usual form only); exactly half are false, not five of twelve; no "7 = 7"; level 2 of the need (make it true, write your own) is missing. Small change (max 10 with all three forms; a fix-it line).
use.note: true or false, within 10 at level 1, within 20 with all three forms above

use.title: Near doubles
use.differs: G1-449 level 1 (doubles-more, mode near) is the bottom half exactly: 6 + 7 = 6 + 6 + □ = □ for 1-9, sums to 19, eight tasks. Missing: the top half, six pairs of ten-frame pictures of a double and its neighbor to write both sums. Small change (a picture row), or use as it is.
use.note: the double is printed at level 1

use.title: Make ten to add
use.differs: G1-439 level 1 (number-line-more, mode bridge) teaches the same step with the same numbers (6-9 plus a number that crosses ten): 8 + 5 = 8 + □ + □ = □, on a number line 0-20. Needed: two ten-frames with counters to cross out and redraw, and the frame 8 + 5 = 10 + _ = _; then empty frames, then equations only. Medium change: a new mode with the double ten-frame in place of the number line.
use.note: level 1 is addition only, across ten, with the first task worked

use.title: Think addition to subtract
use.differs: G1-222 level 3 has the right facts (two one-digit parts that cross ten, wholes 11-18) and missing-number facts such as 8 + □ = 13 and 13 − □ = 5, but all three numbers stand on the roof, so nothing has to be worked out, and a task is not the trio "subtraction, bond with one part missing, helper addition". Medium change: a new card layout in the fact-family generator.
use.note: built: the trio subtraction, number bond with one part empty, helper addition (Think Addition to Subtract)

use.title: How many more? How many fewer?
use.differs: G1-511 is this story kind (how many more / how many fewer, within 10 or 20, two or three stories) with the two amounts printed as two rows of pictures and one box for the difference. Missing: the two rows of 20 empty squares the child colors, and the equation line (7 + _ = 12 or 12 − 7 = _). Medium change (empty bars to color and an equation frame).
use.note: compare stories with the two amounts as rows of pictures

use.title: Teen numbers: one ten and some ones
use.differs: G1-120 (base-ten-tasks, mode read) shows rods and cubes and asks for the number, but the tens run 1-5 or 1-9, never fixed at one, and there is no "1 ten _ ones" line. The bottom half (draw one rod and the cubes for a written number) is missing; G1-121 only circles a ready block set. Small change: a level with one ten only, the tens-and-ones line, and a draw row.
use.note: built: exactly one ten-rod and 1 to 9 ones with the frame 1 rod, _ ones, = _ (Teen Numbers: One Ten and Some Ones)

use.title: Count the tens: 10 to 90
use.differs: G1-122 level 2 (base-ten-tasks, mode count-tens) is the top half: 2-9 ten-rods and no cubes, write how many tens and the number. Differs: the frame reads "□ × 10 = □" (a multiplication sign in Grade 1) in place of "_ tens 0 ones"; level 1 has 1-5 rods; the bottom half (draw the rods for 10-90) is missing. Small change.
use.note: built: ten-rods only, the frame shows a rod picture in place of the times sign (Count the Tens: 10 to 90)

use.title: Add tens to a number
use.differs: G1-446 level 1 (addsub-more, mode mental100) has these equations among others: it MIXES adding and taking away tens or ones, with no option for "plus a multiple of ten" only. Missing too: the small hundreds chart on top and the missing-number form 34 + _ = 64. G1-132 only does 10 more / 10 less. Small change (a kind "add tens" and a missing-addend flag).
use.note: built: level 1 adds whole tens only (34 + 20)

use.title: Subtract tens from tens
use.differs: G2-205 (base-ten-tasks, mode sub) draws two block groups and asks the difference, but both numbers always have ones (never whole tens), the second number is a second picture, not rods to cross out, and there is no "7 tens − 3 tens = _ tens" line. G1-446 level 1 has take-away-tens equations mixed with other kinds. Medium change: a whole-tens level with rods to cross out and the tens sentence.
use.note: built: whole tens minus whole tens with rods to cross out (Subtract Tens from Tens)

use.title: Add ones to a two-digit number
use.differs: G1-446 level 1 holds these equations (two-digit plus ones, no new ten) mixed with adding and taking tens; no pictures and no place-value frame. G2-203 draws both numbers as blocks, but the second number always has tens. Medium change: a base-ten "add ones" level (second number 1-9, printed 32 + 5 = □) and the tens-and-ones frame for level 2.
use.note: built: level 1 adds ones only, no new ten (32 + 5)

use.title: Add ones and make a new ten
use.differs: G1-439 level 3 (mode bridge, within 100) is the same step: 27 + 5 = 27 + □ + □ = □, to the next ten and then the rest, but on a number line, alternating with subtraction, and with no rods and cubes to ring. G1-446 level 2 has bare equations of this kind mixed with others. Medium change: a rods-and-cubes level and an addition-only option with the frame 27 + 5 = 30 + _ = _.
use.note: built: addition only within 100, to the next ten first (27 + 5)

use.title: Add two two-digit numbers: tens with tens, ones with ones
use.differs: G2-203 levels 1-2 (base-ten-tasks, mode add) is level 1 of the need: two two-digit numbers drawn as rods and cubes, no new ten, sum up to 99, write the total. Missing: the line "_ tens and _ ones = _", the printed sum in numerals, and level 2 with the frame (30 + 20) + (4 + 5). Small change (a tens-and-ones line; an equation-only level).
use.note: two two-digit numbers as rods and cubes, no new ten

use.title: Match the clocks
use.differs: G1-150 level 3 (clock-tasks, mode match) is the top half: six clocks on the hour and at half past, lines to six digital times. Missing: the bottom half, where the child WRITES the time in an empty digital display and picks the right clock of two for a half-hour time. Small change: a write-the-time mode of the clock factory.
use.note: clocks to the hour and half hour matched to digital times

use.title: Halves and fourths
use.differs: Two existing pages cover levels 1 and 2. G2-232 (circle the shapes cut into EQUAL parts) is level 1, but its levels use 2 parts only, or 2, 3 and 4 parts (thirds are not wanted), and the child does not write "halves / fourths". G2-407 level 2 is level 2 exactly (draw lines to cut rectangles, squares and circles into halves and fourths). Level 3 (four sentences) is missing. Small change (parts [2, 4] and a name line).
use.note: two pages: circle the shapes cut into equal parts; halves and fourths

use.title: Make ten to add
use.differs: G1-439 level 1 (number-line-more, mode bridge) has the same sums and the same split: 8 + 5 = 8 + □ + □ = □ (the part that makes ten first), sums 11-18, first number 6-9. Differs: the split is written in the equation over a number line 0-20, not in two circles under the second addend; no ten-frames on the first tasks; no line "= 10 + _"; no turned-around sums; four tasks a page. Small change.
use.note: level 1 is addition only, across ten

use.title: Doubles and near doubles
use.differs: Three existing pages cover the three parts: G1-449 level 2 is the middle part exactly (7 + 8 = □ + □ + 1 = □, either order); G1-298 writes doubles from memory (2-10, not only 5-9); G1-299 halves. No page holds all three, and the bottom part (16 − 8, 15 − 7 as halves of doubles and near them) exists only as "half of 16". Small change, or use G1-449 as the page.
use.note: near doubles in either order; doubles and halves are their own pages

use.title: Use ten to subtract
use.differs: G1-439 level 2 (mode bridge) has the same subtractions and the same split: 15 − 7 = 15 − □ − □ = □ (back to ten first), from 11-17, on a number line 0-20. Differs: it alternates with addition (no subtraction-only option); the split is in the equation, not in two circles; no ten-frames to cross out; the form "10 − _ = _" is not printed. Small change (subtraction only; the split layout).
use.note: built: subtraction only, back to ten first (15 - 7)

use.title: Ten tens make one hundred
use.differs: G2-404 level 1 (pv-more, mode overflow) shows 11-18 ten-rods, but always with 1-9 loose ones as well, and asks only for the number: no ring, no "1 hundred _ tens". G2-403 renames in digits (26 tens = □). The bottom half (1-9 hundred-flats alone, "_ hundreds 0 tens 0 ones") does not exist: G2-222 always has tens and ones. Small change (rods only, the hundred-and-tens line, a flats-only level).
use.note: more than nine tens with ones: write the number (level 1 is too many tens, level 2 too many ones)

use.title: Numbers with a zero
use.differs: The pieces exist on separate pages: G2-401 level 3 (expanded form both ways with a zero place), G2-491 level 3 (numbers with a zero digit as words and numerals), G2-224 (blocks to a place-value chart). No page has the four-column table blocks / numeral / expanded form / name, the look-alike pairs 406 and 460 one under the other, or the last task (58, 508, 580). Medium change: a table mode of pv-more.js.
use.note: expanded form both ways with a zero place

use.title: Add tens and ones, then put them together
use.differs: G3-359 level 1 has the same sums (two two-digit numbers, a new ten, up to 99) but as a column sum with a carry box. G2-203 draws both numbers as blocks but never with a new ten. Missing in both: the empty tens-and-ones mat for sticks and dots and the three partial-sum lines (40 + 30 = _, 7 + 8 = _, _ + _ = _). Not small: a new partial-sums mode (the same one as en-1-042).
use.note: built: the three partial-sum lines under each sum (Add Tens and Ones); the sticks-and-dots drawing is done on scrap paper

use.title: Add three-digit numbers and make a new ten or hundred
use.differs: G3-361 is the written part: three-digit column addition with carrying and a carry row (levels set one or at least two carries), sums up to 999. Missing: the hundreds-tens-ones mat beside each sum for the drawing, and the fixed mix (three new tens, two new hundreds, three both). Small change (a mat panel; six or nine problems today).
use.note: column addition of three-digit numbers with carrying

use.title: Subtract three-digit numbers and open a ten or a hundred
use.differs: Three-digit subtraction with borrowing exists only mixed with addition (G3-357 level 3, G3-363 level 3); G3-360 is subtraction only but two-digit. Missing: a subtraction-only three-digit level with no zero in the first number, the mat with the first number drawn, and "Enough ones? Enough tens?". Small for the numbers (a config of the column factory), medium for the mat.
use.note: built: subtraction only in columns, three-digit numbers, one regrouping on level 2 and two on level 3

use.title: Subtract across a zero
use.differs: G3-362 is the written part: three-digit column subtraction across a zero (level 3: two zeros, so whole hundreds). Missing: the hundreds-tens-ones mat, the two half-worked tasks, and the line below each task to check by adding. Small to medium change.
use.note: column subtraction across a zero

use.title: Count mixed coins
use.differs: Counting Coins (G1-211) at level 3, and better its face G1-229 (4-8 mixed coins with quarters, largest first, total up to 99 cents), is this page. Missing: the small box under each coin for the running count, totals kept at 26 or more, and the top level "make the amount in two ways" (G2-472 circles coins for a price, one way). Small change (boxes under the coins).
use.note: count mixed coins, largest first

use.unit: Bar Graphs, Picture Graphs, and Line Plots
use.title: Make a picture graph
use.differs: G1-147 (graph-tasks, mode pict-fill) is the middle of the page: a table of counts and an empty picture graph, one box for each. Missing: title and group names to write, and the five questions with equation lines (how many more, how many in all); G2-237 asks two such questions under a bar graph. Small to medium change (a question block under the graph; a column version).
use.note: a table of counts and an empty picture graph

use.title: Break a hard fact into two easy ones
use.differs: Must be built: dot arrays for facts with 6-9 split after the fifth row, with 7 × 8 = 5 × 8 + 2 × 8 = _ + _ = _. G3-410 (strategy chains) uses other tricks (double, ×10 and halve, ×10 minus one group); a new "split" mode of md-more.js.
use.note: built (nothing was close): an array of squares the child cuts between two rows into two known facts (Break Apart a Hard Fact)

use.title: The facts we still need
use.differs: Page 1: G3-407 level 3 is the empty 10 × 10 multiplication square, but the child fills ALL of it; the steps "fill the rows for 1, 2, 5, 10, circle what is white, write those facts" and the lines for them are not there. Page 2: G3-408 and G3-358 drill division or multiplication alone; no strips of ten pairs (6 × 4 = _, 24 / 4 = _) with a "knew right away" box. Small to medium change.
use.note: the empty 10 by 10 square, filled in the order the teacher gives

use.title: Unit fractions on the number line
use.differs: G3-406 (number-line-more, mode fraction) gives a 0-1 line cut into equal parts and the child puts a dot where a printed fraction belongs (denominators 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 over levels 1-2), but for any numerator, with the fraction given, and the ticks always drawn. Needed: the first part only, the child WRITES the unit fraction, then lines with no ticks to cut, and the unequal-parts question. Small change for the top half (unit fractions, a write box); the bottom half is new.
use.note: built: a dot on a number line from 0 to 1, the child writes its fraction; levels 1 and 2 unit fractions only (What Fraction Is the Dot?)

use.unit: Zahlen bis 10: zählen, schreiben, vergleichen und zerlegen
use.title: Zahlen 1 bis 5: zählen und Ziffern schreiben
use.differs: K-467 level 1 has one row per number 1 to 5 with that many pictures and the numeral to trace (a model, then two traces) in the German school digit forms. Missing: the dice pattern beside each set, boxes to write the numeral three times alone, and the matching strip at the bottom (that strip exists as its own page, K-007). No build needed if K-467 + K-007 are used as two pages; a dice picture and free boxes would be a small option of number-tracing-more.js mode count.
use.note: eine Zeile je Zahl von 1 bis 5 mit der Ziffer zum Nachspuren

use.unit: Zahlen bis 10: zählen, schreiben, vergleichen und zerlegen
use.title: Zahlen 6 bis 10: fünf und noch mehr
use.differs: Three existing pages cover the three parts: K-004 (count a filled ten-frame, write the number; level 3 runs 4 to 10, there is no 6 to 10 setting), K-005 (draw the given number into an empty frame), K-250 / K-252 (trace 5 to 9 / 1 to 10). They are not one page, and the range 6 to 10 with the top row always full cannot be selected; a min/max knob in frame-counting.js is a small change. No build needed if two or three pages are acceptable.
use.note: drei Seiten: Zehnerfeld zählen, Zahl ins Feld malen, Ziffern schreiben

use.unit: Zahlen bis 10: zählen, schreiben, vergleichen und zerlegen
use.title: Mehr, weniger, gleich viele: die Zeichen <, > und =
use.differs: G1-114 shows two picture groups (up to 10) and the three symbols; the child circles the symbol instead of writing both numbers and the sign, and does not pair the pictures with lines. Number pairs to 10 exist as K-460 level 1 (not published) or G1-137 level 1 (to 20, never =). Missing everywhere: the sentences to turn into symbols (5 ist kleiner als 8). Small change: a write-in variant of picture-equation.js mode compare plus a sentence row.
use.note: zwei Bildgruppen und das passende Zeichen

use.unit: Zahlen bis 10: zählen, schreiben, vergleichen und zerlegen
use.title: Die Zahlenreihe bis 10: Vorgänger und Nachfolger
use.differs: K-021 level 1 is the Vorgaenger, Zahl, Nachfolger part (given numbers 1 to 9, 5 rows instead of 8). The two bead chains with missing numbers are separate existing pages: K-019 (1 to 10 forward) and K-023 (10 to 1 backward). No generator change needed if two or three pages are used; one combined page would only be a new layout.
use.note: Vorgänger und Nachfolger, dazu die Zahlenketten vorwärts und rückwärts

use.unit: Zahlen bis 10: zählen, schreiben, vergleichen und zerlegen
use.title: Zahlen zerlegen: die Schüttelbox
use.differs: K-457 does the covered-side part (the whole is printed, some pictures show, the rest hide under a cup, the child writes the hidden part), but its totals are only 5 (level 1), 10 (level 2) or 11 to 16 (level 3), not 2 to 9, it draws a cup and not a Schuettelbox, and it has no boxes with both sides visible where the child writes both parts. A Schuettelbox drawing with a totals option would be a new mode of number-bond-more.js (small to medium).
use.note: gebaut: Mengen von 2 bis 9 unter dem Becher (Stufe 1: 2 bis 5, Stufe 2: 6 bis 9)

use.unit: Zahlen bis 10: zählen, schreiben, vergleichen und zerlegen
use.title: Zahlenhäuser: alle Zerlegungen finden
use.differs: K-456 level 2 is the Zahlenhaus for 6 to 10 with one floor per decomposition (1 to N-1, in order), but one part is already printed on every floor and the child only writes the partner; here the child must find all decompositions on empty floors and mark the Tauschpaare. Two houses a page, not four. Small change: a level with empty floors in number-bond-more.js mode house. (K-414 to K-417 level 3 list every way to split 6, 7, 8, 9 as number bonds.)
use.note: gebaut: Zahlenhäuser mit leeren Stockwerken, das Kind findet alle Zerlegungen selbst (Stufe 2: 6 bis 8)

use.unit: Plus und Minus bis 10: dazutun und wegnehmen
use.title: Tauschaufgaben: 2 + 5 und 5 + 2
use.differs: G1-113 shows two picture groups and the child finishes a + b and b + a (plus the two subtractions, which this page does not want); the numbers are printed, only the results are blank. Missing: counter rows in two colours shown in both orders, writing the Tauschaufgabe to a given task, ticking the easier one. A turnaround mode of picture-equation.js would be a small to medium change.
use.note: gebaut: zwei Bildgruppen und nur die beiden Plusaufgaben (Tauschaufgaben), Summen 6 bis 10

use.title: Rechts, links, oben, unten: Wege im Kästchenplan
use.differs: Existing but outside the mathematics catalog list (Maps and Coordinates maker): G1-528 gives steps as arrows with a number of squares on a 4x4 or 5x5 picture grid and the child circles where she lands; G1-529 shows a drawn route on a 5x5 or 6x6 grid and the child writes each part as arrow + number of squares. Differs: no start, goal and obstacles on an empty Kaestchenplan into which the child draws the path, and the part "what lies left, right, above, below the beetle" is missing. Small to medium change (a draw-the-path variant with obstacles on the same route engine).
use.note: zwei Seiten: Schritten folgen, Wege angeben

use.unit: Plus und Minus bis 10: Aufgabenfamilien und Rechengeschichten
use.title: Rechengeschichten erfinden
use.differs: Two existing pages make the two halves. G1-444 level 3: a picture of two groups or of crossed-out things, the child writes the whole number sentence within 10 (top half). G1-513 (its German title is Rechengeschichten erfinden): a number sentence with a picture and lines to WRITE a story, not an empty field to draw in (bottom half). No build needed if writing lines are acceptable; a drawing-box option in G1-513 is a small change.
use.note: zwei Seiten: die Rechnung zum Bild schreiben, eine Rechengeschichte erfinden

use.unit: Zahlen bis 20: Zehner, Einer und Zahlenstrahl
use.title: Zahlen bis 20 im Zwanzigerfeld: ein Zehner und Einer
use.differs: K-448 level 2 shows a full ten-frame plus a second one for 11 to 20; the child writes the number and __ = 10 + __. Missing: the line "1 Zehner und _ Einer" and the four empty Zwanzigerfelder to draw 12, 15, 17, 20 into (drawing teen numbers into frames exists in K-452 level 3). The two frames stand side by side, four cards a page. Small change in frame-more.js mode double-frame.
use.note: ein volles Zehnerfeld und ein zweites: Zahl und Gleichung schreiben

use.unit: Rechnen bis 20: kleine und große Aufgaben, Verdoppeln und Zahlenmauern
use.title: Kleine Aufgabe, große Aufgabe: 3 + 4 und 13 + 4
use.differs: G1-216 level 1 (plus) and G1-217 level 1 (minus) are pages of exactly the big tasks: a teen number and a one-digit number, never crossing ten (12 + 5, 17 - 5). Missing: the paired small task printed with it (3 + 4 beside 13 + 4), the Zwanzigerfeld picture, and the last block where the child writes the small task itself. A pairs knob in the mental-math generator (G1-208 family) is a small to medium change.
use.note: gebaut: die kleine Aufgabe über der großen (3 + 4 und 13 + 4); Stufe 1 Plus, Stufe 2 Minus, Stufe 3 beides

use.unit: Plus und Minus bis 20 mit Zehnerübergang
use.title: Plus über die 10: erst bis zur 10, dann weiter
use.differs: G1-439 level 1 is the same two-step task with the same written line (8 + 5 = 8 + _ + _ = _, sums 11 to 18), but on a ticked 0 to 20 number line where the child draws two jumps, not on a Zwanzigerfeld where the second number is drawn in blue; 4 cards a page, the first one worked. No build needed if the number line is accepted; a ten-frame variant would be a new mode (frame-more.js), small to medium.
use.note: Stufe 1 ist nur Plus über die 10, die erste Aufgabe ist vorgemacht

use.unit: Plus und Minus bis 20 mit Zehnerübergang
use.title: Verdoppeln hilft: 6 + 7
use.differs: G1-449 level 2 has the child rewrite 6 + 7 as 6 + 6 + 1 and write the sum (within 20). Missing: the doubling task solved beside it with two counter rows, circling the one extra counter, the sentence "6 + 7 ist _ mehr als 6 + 6, weil ...", and matching eight tasks to their doubling task. Small to medium change in doubles-more.js mode near.
use.note: 6 + 7 als 6 + 6 + 1 schreiben

use.unit: Plus und Minus bis 20 mit Zehnerübergang
use.title: Minus über die 10: erst zurück zur 10
use.differs: G1-439 level 2 has the back-to-ten steps with the written line 13 - _ - _ = _ (start numbers 11 to 17), but minus cards alternate with plus cards (there is no minus-only setting) and it uses a ticked number line instead of a Zwanzigerfeld whose counters are crossed out. Minus-only is a small option of number-line-more.js mode bridge; a ten-frame variant is a new mode.
use.note: gebaut: nur Minus, zuerst zurück zur 10

use.unit: Ausblick bis 100: Zehnerzahlen, Zählen in Schritten und Geld
use.title: In Zehnern bündeln: die Zehnerzahlen bis 100
use.differs: G2-206 has the child circle ten loose ones and write tens and ones, but only for 11 to 19 cubes (one bundle); the page needs 30 to 80 loose things with several tens to circle and "_ Zehner = _". Raising the range of base-ten-tasks.js mode regroup is a small to medium change. The other two parts exist as pages: G1-122 (ten-rods to number) and G1-123 (10, 20 ... 100).
use.note: gebaut: 31 bis 59 lose Einer, Zehner einkreisen, Zehner und Einer notieren (Stufe 3: 51 bis 79)

use.unit: Plus und Minus bis 100: Einer, Zehner und Zehnerübergang
use.title: Zehnerzahlen dazu und weg: 34 + 20 und 76 − 30
use.differs: G1-446 level 1 contains exactly these tasks (34 + 20, 76 - 30) but mixed half and half with ones tasks, results only. Missing: the block of pure tens beside the small task (40 + 30 with 4 + 3) and the hundred-chart sections on which the jumps are drawn (chart jumps exist as arrows in G2-321, plus/minus 10 as G1-132). A tens-only kind in addsub-more.js mode mental100 is small; the chart sections are a new layout (medium).
use.note: gebaut: nur Zehnerzahlen, Stufe 3 mischt dazu und weg

use.unit: Plus und Minus bis 100: Einer, Zehner und Zehnerübergang
use.title: Einer dazu und weg ohne Zehnerübergang: 43 + 5 und 68 − 4
use.differs: G1-446 level 1 contains these tasks (43 + 5, 68 - 4, never crossing a ten) but mixed with tens tasks, results only. Missing: the pairs small task / big task, the rods-and-cubes picture of the bigger number, and writing the small task oneself. A pairs option in addsub-more.js mode mental100 is a small to medium change.
use.note: gebaut: nur Einer ohne Zehnerübergang; die kleine Aufgabe (3 + 4 neben 23 + 4) schreibt die Lehrkraft an die Tafel

use.unit: Plus und Minus bis 100: Einer, Zehner und Zehnerübergang
use.title: Plus mit Zehnerübergang: 47 + 8
use.differs: G1-439 level 3 is this task within 100 with the written line 47 + 8 = 47 + _ + _ = _ and two jumps via the ten, but (1) plus and minus cards alternate on the page, (2) the line is a ticked, numbered section of 20 numbers with the start marked, not an empty Rechenstrich, (3) 4 cards a page instead of 12. Plus-only and an unticked line are small options of number-line-more.js mode bridge.
use.note: gebaut: nur Plus bis 100 mit einstelliger Zahl, erst bis zum nächsten Zehner (47 + 8 = 47 + 3 + 5), am Zahlenstrahl

use.unit: Plus und Minus bis 100: Einer, Zehner und Zehnerübergang
use.title: Minus mit Zehnerübergang: 53 − 6
use.differs: G1-439 level 3 is this task within 100 with the written line 53 - 6 = 53 - _ - _ = _ and two jumps back via the ten, but (1) minus cards alternate with plus cards, (2) the line is a ticked, numbered section of 20 numbers, not an empty Rechenstrich with the start on the right, (3) 4 cards a page instead of 12. Minus-only and an unticked line are small options of number-line-more.js mode bridge.
use.note: gebaut: Stufe 3 ist Minus bis 100 mit einstelliger Zahl, erst zurück zum Zehner (53 − 6 = 53 − 3 − 3)

use.unit: Plus und Minus bis 100: zweistellige Zahlen, Rechenwege und Sachaufgaben
use.title: Zweistellige Zahlen addieren: 35 + 23 und 48 + 37
use.differs: G1-438 level 2 gives two-digit plus/minus two-digit tasks within 100 on an empty line (a real Rechenstrich: no ticks); the child draws the jumps and writes the result. Differs: plus and minus are mixed, every task crosses a ten (no block without Zehneruebergang), 4 cards a page, and there are no two lines for the written steps (48 + 30 = 78, 78 + 7 = 85). Operation and crossing knobs plus step lines are a small to medium change in number-line-more.js mode open.
use.note: gebaut: nur Plus am Rechenstrich, Stufe 1 ohne Zehnerübergang, Stufe 2 und 3 mit; die Sprünge am Strich sind die Zwischenschritte

use.unit: Plus und Minus bis 100: zweistellige Zahlen, Rechenwege und Sachaufgaben
use.title: Zweistellige Zahlen subtrahieren: 67 − 24 und 82 − 35
use.differs: G1-438 level 2 gives two-digit minus two-digit tasks within 100 on an empty line (a real Rechenstrich); the child draws the jumps and writes the result. Differs: minus is mixed with plus, every task crosses a ten (no block without Zehneruebergang), 4 cards a page, and there are no two lines for the written steps (82 - 30 = 52, 52 - 5 = 47). Operation and crossing knobs plus step lines are a small to medium change in number-line-more.js mode open.
use.note: gebaut: nur Minus am Rechenstrich, Stufe 1 ohne Zehnerübergang, Stufe 2 und 3 mit; die Sprünge am Strich sind die Zwischenschritte

use.unit: Das kleine Einmaleins: von den Kernaufgaben zu allen Reihen
use.title: Das 10er-Einmaleins und die Kernaufgaben
use.differs: G3-366 is the 10er-Reihe as ten equations to fill (level 1 with 1 mal, 5 mal and 10 mal already worked), without ten-rod pictures. The second half does not exist: dot fields for the Kernaufgaben 1 mal, 2 mal, 5 mal, 10 mal of the rows 3, 4 and 6, and colouring them in a row list. Medium change: a core-facts mode in the times-table generator (G3-358) or in array-tasks.js.
use.note: die 10er-Reihe mit den vorgemachten Kernaufgaben

use.unit: Das kleine Einmaleins: von den Kernaufgaben zu allen Reihen
use.title: Das 4er- und das 8er-Einmaleins: verdoppeln
use.differs: The two row pages exist exactly, in the same form as Das 2er-Einmaleins: G3-368 (4er) and G3-404 (8er). Only the extra table with three rows (2er, 4er, 8er) for doubling downwards is missing; G3-410 levels 1 and 2 carry the same idea as fact chains (mal 4 = mal 2 mal 2, mal 8 = mal 4 mal 2) but is not published. No build needed if that is accepted; the table itself would be a small add-on.
use.note: die Reihenseiten 4er und 8er

use.unit: Das kleine Einmaleins: von den Kernaufgaben zu allen Reihen
use.title: Das 3er- und das 6er-Einmaleins
use.differs: The two row pages exist exactly, in the same form as Das 2er-Einmaleins: G3-367 (3er) and G3-402 (6er). Only the extra table with two rows (3er, 6er) for doubling is missing; G3-410 has no chain "mal 6 = mal 3 mal 2". A small add-on (a new chain kind in md-more.js mode chain, or a doubling table).
use.note: die Reihenseiten 3er und 6er

use.unit: Das kleine Einmaleins: von den Kernaufgaben zu allen Reihen
use.title: Das 9er- und das 7er-Einmaleins: von den Kernaufgaben aus
use.differs: G3-410 level 2 has the chain "mal 9 = mal 10 minus one group" with boxes to fill, and G3-403 / G3-405 are the complete 7er and 9er rows. Missing: the split 7 mal 8 = 5 mal 8 + 2 mal 8 for the 7er row and the dot field with a dashed helper line for each task. Medium change: a new chain kind plus an array picture in md-more.js mode chain.
use.note: die Ableitungsketten und die Reihenseiten 7er und 9er

use.unit: Das kleine Einmaleins: von den Kernaufgaben zu allen Reihen
use.title: Die Einmaleins-Tafel: Was kann ich schon?
use.differs: G3-407 level 3 is the same printed object: the 10 x 10 multiplication square with only the header row and column filled. Only the instruction differs (it asks for every product; the lesson has the child colour Kernaufgaben and Quadratzahlen, enter what it knows, join Tauschaufgaben, circle what to practise). Usable as it is with the teacher's spoken instruction; an instruction variant is a very small change.
use.note: die leere Einmaleins-Tafel

use.title: Umkehraufgaben: Mal und Geteilt gehören zusammen
use.differs: G3-311 (Mal-Familien) is the page: a dot array and the four related mal and geteilt sentences. Differs: the arrays have 2 to 5 rows and at most 8 columns, so the 10er row never appears, and the four word cards (Malaufgabe, Tauschaufgabe, twice Umkehraufgabe) to assign are missing. Small change in array-tasks.js mode fact-family.
use.note: Punktefeld und die vier Aufgaben der Mal-Familie

use.unit: Zahlen bis 1000: Stellenwerte, Zahlenstrahl und Runden
use.title: Der Zahlenstrahl bis 1000: Nachbarzehner und Nachbarhunderter
use.differs: G2-395 level 3 has ticked number lines in steps of 100 and 10 up to 1000 where the child writes missing tick labels; the arrow pages (write the number an arrow points to, G1-248 family, e.g. G1-281) stop at 120. Missing: arrows on lines to 1000 including a section in ones (630 to 650), marking given numbers, and the table of Nachbarzehner and Nachbarhunderter (G3-391 rounds to 10 and 100, it does not ask for both neighbours). The arrow pages take max, tick and label step as configuration, so a 0 to 1000 face is a small change; the neighbour table would be a new mode of neighbors.js (small to medium).
use.note: Zahlenstrahl in Hunderter- und Zehnerschritten bis 1000

use.title: Zauberquadrate
use.differs: G3-349 is the Zauberquadrat page (3 x 3, some cells empty, the magic number shown, one solution proven), but its numbers are only 1 to 9 (magic number 15) or 4 to 12 (magic number 24); the lesson names the Zahlenraum bis 1000. The generator already has an offset knob; a multiplier or a larger offset is a small change.
use.note: Zauberquadrate 3 mal 3

use.unit: Sortera, uppskatta och dela upp tal
use.title: Klassens diagram: bygg staplar med klossar
use.differs: G1-143 shows a bar graph of picture categories and the child writes each bar's number (level 1: 3 bars up to 5; level 3: 4 bars up to 10); ringing the bar with the most is a separate page (G1-144). So the page exists as two pages, and "3 bars with up to 10" is not one of the settings. No build needed if two pages are acceptable; one combined level is a small change in graph-tasks.js. (G1-481 is the class's own tally and graph for the floor activity.)
use.note: stapeldiagram med bildkategorier: skriv antalet

use.unit: Lägga till, ta bort och lösa problem
use.title: Några kommer till: först, sedan, nu
use.differs: K-028 shows two groups and the child writes how many altogether (totals up to 10), but it prints + and = between the groups, has no three panels foerst / sedan / nu and no empty box in which the child draws all of them. A three-panel story layout without signs would be a new mode (small to medium).
use.note: två grupper: hur många tillsammans

use.unit: Lägga till, ta bort och lösa problem
use.title: Några går iväg: hur många är kvar?
use.differs: K-451 level 2 is the same task and range (3 to 10, some crossed out, write how many are left, at least one left, no number sentence) but shows counters in a ten-frame, not pictures of things. G1-104 shows crossed-out pictures up to 10 but prints the subtraction sentence (7 - 3 = _). No build needed if ten-frame counters are acceptable; otherwise a very small option (hide the sentence in picture-equation.js mode crossout).
use.note: några stryks över: hur många är kvar

use.unit: Lägga till, ta bort och lösa problem
use.title: Dela lika: en till dig, en till mig
use.differs: G2-216 level 1 is the task: a pile of 4 to 12 pictures and 2 or 3 empty bins, the child writes how many each gets. But every card prints the division sentence (8 / 2 = _), which a foerskoleklass page should not carry; 10 shared by 2 is not in level 1 and 12 shared by 3 can occur. Hiding the sentence is a very small option of array-tasks.js mode share-bins.
use.note: byggd: högen och lådorna utan divisionsuttryck (En till dig, en till mig)

use.title: Större än, mindre än och lika med
use.differs: G1-114 is the first part (two picture groups up to 10, the child circles the symbol instead of writing it in a box). Number pairs exist as K-460 level 1 (to 10, not published) or G1-137 level 1 (1 to 20, never =). Ordering three numbers within 10 does not exist (G1-135 orders two-digit numbers). No build needed for parts 1 and 2 if two pages are acceptable; a write-in box and an ordering row within 10 are small changes (picture-equation.js / compare-order.js).
use.note: två bildgrupper och rätt tecken

use.title: Likhetstecknet: lika mycket på båda sidor
use.differs: G1-443 has the child ring true or false for equations, half of them false. But within 10 it only has the form a + b = c (level 1); 5 = 2 + 3 and 3 + 1 = 2 + 2 come at levels 2 and 3, where the numbers go to 20. Missing: the empty balance to draw dots on and the line to rewrite the false ones. A within-10 level with all three forms is a small change in addsub-more.js mode truefalse; the balance drawing and rewrite line are extra (small to medium).
use.note: sant eller falskt; likhetstecknet åt båda håll kommer på nivå 2 och 3

use.title: Stegvisa instruktioner: styr skalbaggen
use.differs: Existing but outside the mathematics catalog list (Maps and Coordinates maker): G1-528 level 1 is a 4x4 picture grid with steps as arrow + words (move 2 squares right) and the child rings where she lands; G1-529 shows a drawn route and the child writes each part as arrow + number of squares. Differs: the child does not draw the path of a given arrow row to a goal and does not write a route of its own choosing; steps are right/left/up/down with a count, not forward / turn left / turn right. Small to medium change on the same route engine.
use.note: två sidor: följ stegen, skriv stegen

use.title: Samma ental, en tia till: 3 + 4 och 13 + 4
use.differs: G1-216 level 1 (plus) and G1-217 level 1 (minus) are pages of exactly the big tasks: a number 11 to 19 and a one-digit number, never crossing ten (13 + 4, 17 - 5). Missing: the paired small task printed with it (3 + 4 beside 13 + 4) and the two tiorutor to draw counters in. A pairs knob in the mental-math generator (G1-208 family) is a small to medium change.
use.note: byggd: den lilla uppgiften över den stora (3 + 4 och 13 + 4); nivå 1 addition, nivå 2 subtraktion, nivå 3 båda

use.title: Dubblor och nästan-dubblor
use.differs: G1-449 has 6 + 7 rewritten as 6 + 6 + 1 with the sum, within 20 (level 1: the double is printed). Differs: there are no two equal rows of dots, and the double's own sum (6 + 6 = 12) is never written (the doubles themselves are on G1-298). Small change in doubles-more.js mode near.
use.note: 6 + 7 skrivet som 6 + 6 + 1

use.title: Tiotalsövergång i addition: fyll tian först
use.differs: G1-439 level 1 is the same task with the same mellanled (8 + 5 = 8 + _ + _ = _, sums 11 to 18), but on a ticked 0 to 20 number line where the child draws two jumps, not with two tiorutor and a split fork under the second term; 4 cards a page, the first one worked. No build needed if the number line is accepted; a ten-frame and fork variant would be a new mode (small to medium).
use.note: nivå 1 är bara addition över tio, första uppgiften är löst

use.title: Tiotalsövergång i subtraktion: först ner till tian
use.differs: G1-439 level 2 is this task (13 - 5 = 13 - _ - _ = _ with two jumps back on a number line, first term 11 to 17), but minus cards alternate with plus cards and the line is ticked and labelled every 5, not empty with only 10 marked. Minus-only and a bare line are small options of number-line-more.js mode bridge.
use.note: byggd: bara subtraktion, först ner till tian

use.title: Hur många fler? Jämföra två antal
use.differs: G1-511 level 2 has compare stories within 20 (how many more) with the two rows of pictures already drawn one under the other; the child writes only the difference. Missing: two empty bars to colour, the bracket for the difference and the written calculation (G1-448 level 3 has two drawn bars to compare, numbers to 20, no story). Small to medium change: an empty-bar variant in the word-problem engine.
use.note: jämförelsehändelser med två bildrader

use.title: Rita, räkna, svara
use.differs: G1-213 level 2 has two stories within 20, each with a show-your-thinking panel and an answer box. But it prints the picture strip that the child is meant to draw here, it has no four labelled fields (Rita, Raekna, Svar, Staemmer det?), and two problems, not three (G1-241 has three, within 10). A four-step frame without the picture strip is a small to medium change in the word-problem generator.
use.note: två räknehändelser med ruta för uträkning och svar

use.unit: Utblick mot 100: tiotal, ental och kronor
use.title: Bunta tio: tiotal och ental
use.differs: G2-206 has the child ring ten loose cubes and write tens and ones, but only for 11 to 19 (one bundle). The page needs 20 to 60 scattered things with several tens to ring and the line "tiotal: _, ental: _, talet: _". Raising the range of base-ten-tasks.js mode regroup is a small to medium change.
use.note: byggd: 31 till 59 lösa ental, ringa in tiotal, skriv tiotal och ental (nivå 1: 21 till 39)

use.unit: Utblick mot 100: tiotal, ental och kronor
use.title: Betala på olika sätt
use.differs: G2-472 level 3 has the child draw coins (1, 2, 5, 10 kr) that pay a price exactly, one way per price, prices up to 50 kr; G2-471 asks for the fewest coins; G2-473 matches purses holding the same amount. Missing: two purses per thing to draw two different ways and ring the one with fewer coins, with prices 5 to 20 kr. Small change in money-more.js mode pay.
use.note: rita mynt som betalar priset exakt

use.unit: Addition och subtraktion 0–100: huvudräkning med tiotal och ental
use.title: Addera och subtrahera hela tiotal
use.differs: G1-446 level 1 contains the last-row tasks (34 + 20, 76 - 30) mixed half and half with ones tasks, results only. Missing: the pairs 3 + 4 and 30 + 40 or 9 - 2 and 90 - 20 with tiostavar drawn beside them, which are most of the page. A tens-only kind with pairs in addsub-more.js mode mental100 is a small to medium change.
use.note: byggd: bara hela tiotal, nivå 3 blandar plus och minus

use.unit: Addition och subtraktion 0–100: huvudräkning med tiotal och ental
use.title: Tiotalsövergång upp till 100: 38 + 5 och 43 − 5
use.differs: G1-439 level 3 is this page: tasks like 38 + 5 and 43 - 5 within 100, plus and minus in turn, the mellanled 38 + 5 = 38 + _ + _ = _ and two jumps via the nearest ten. The one difference that matters: the line is a ticked, numbered section of 20 numbers with the start marked, not a tom tallinje; 4 cards a page. Hiding the ticks is a small option of number-line-more.js mode bridge.
use.note: sidan för lektionen: plus och minus i tur och ordning upp till 100

use.unit: Addition och subtraktion 0–100: huvudräkning med tiotal och ental
use.title: Addera tvåsiffriga tal: talsorterna var för sig
use.differs: G1-446 level 3 has these sums (two-digit plus/minus two-digit within 100, half across a ten) but asks only for the result and mixes in subtraction. The template for mellanled (tiotal + tiotal, ental + ental, summa) is missing, and it is the point of the page. Small to medium change in addsub-more.js mode mental100.
use.note: byggd: mall för mellanled under varje addition, tiotal för sig, ental för sig, summa (nivå 2 med tiotalsövergång)

use.unit: Addition och subtraktion 0–100: huvudräkning med tiotal och ental
use.title: Subtrahera tvåsiffriga tal på tom tallinje
use.differs: G1-438 level 2 has two-digit minus two-digit on an empty number line (a tom tallinje) with the jumps drawn by the child, but mixed with addition, always across a ten, 4 cards a page, and with no pairs of close numbers (61 - 58) to count up. Minus-only and a close-numbers kind are small to medium changes in number-line-more.js mode open.
use.note: byggd: bara subtraktion på tom tallinje, tiotalen först; talpar nära varandra (61 − 58) räknar klassen upp på tavlans tallinje

use.title: Liter och deciliter
use.differs: G2-260 level 1 is the same jug (1000 ml with a tick every 100 ml, six jugs to read) but labelled and answered in millilitres; with dl labels it is the litermaatt with one tick per decilitre. Missing besides the unit: colouring a jug to a given level and ringing more or less than 1 litre for everyday containers. A dl unit option on the jug page is a small change.
use.note: byggd: mätkannan graderad i deciliter (1 liter = 10 streck; nivå 3 två liter)

use.title: Dubbelt och hälften upp till 100
use.differs: G1-451 level 3 has doubling and halving up to 100 as machines (fill the outputs, some inputs), results only. Missing: the numbers drawn as tiostavar and entalskuber to draw once more or to split into two piles, and the written mellanled (dubbelt av 34 = 60 + 8 = 68). Small to medium change in doubles-more.js.
use.note: dubbelt och hälften upp till 100 som maskiner

use.title: Fem i halv och fem över halv
use.differs: G1-477 level 3 is the first part: six clocks on five-minute times and lines to the time in Swedish words (lib/time-words.js has fem i halv, halv, fem oever halv, tjugo i, tio oever). The second part, drawing the minute hand from a time written in words, is missing: G1-236 (draw the hands, five minutes) prints the time as a digital chip. A word prompt for the draw mode is noted in the code as a planned follow-up: a small change.
use.note: klockor på femminuterstider mot tiden i ord

use.title: Programmera med pilar i rutnät
use.differs: Existing but outside the mathematics catalog list (Maps and Coordinates maker): G1-528 level 2 gives a program of steps (arrow + number of squares) on a 5x5 picture grid and the child marks where the figure lands; G1-529 has the child write the steps of a drawn route on a 6x6 grid. Differs: no obstacles, grid 5x5 for following, and the child writes a given route, not a program of its own around obstacles to a goal. Small to medium change on the same route engine.
use.note: ett program med pilar och antal rutor

use.title: Förstora och förminska i rutnät
use.differs: K-502 Draw It Twice as Big exists (Symmetry and Grid Copy maker, outside the mathematics catalog list): a picture on a small grid is redrawn twice as big; at level 3 on a grid with twice as many squares, each square becoming a block of 2 x 2. Differs: the pictures are filled-square pixel pictures, not line figures whose sides the child counts, and there is no half-as-big task. Small to medium change in grid-copy-more.js mode bigger.
use.note: rita bilden dubbelt så stor

use.title: 6:ans tabell ur tabeller du kan
use.differs: G3-410 is the strategy-chain page (fill the boxes of a chain that builds a product from known ones), but only for 4, 5, 8 and 9: there is no chain 6 x 7 = 5 x 7 + 1 x 7 and no array of 6 rows split into 5 rows and 1 row. G3-402 is the complete table of 6 to fill at the end. Small to medium change: a new chain kind with an array picture in md-more.js mode chain.
use.note: byggd: kedjor som bygger 6:ans tabell ur 5:ans (nivå 1), 6:ans och 7:ans (nivå 2), 7:ans (nivå 3)

use.title: 7:ans, 8:ans och 9:ans tabell: bryt isär den svåra
use.differs: G3-410 level 2 has the second part as a chain to fill: 9 times n = 10 times n minus one group. The first part is missing: arrays for 7 x 7 to 9 x 9 that the child splits with its own line into two known parts, writing both part products and the sum. G3-403, G3-404, G3-405 are the complete tables of 7, 8 and 9. Medium change: a split-array kind in md-more.js mode chain.
use.note: byggd: rutnät för 7 · 7 till 9 · 9 som eleven delar med ett eget streck; 9:ans tabell skrivs på G3-405

G2-243.title: Name the solid shapes
G2-243.differs: G2-243 (geometry-tasks, mode solid-real) is the top half: a line from each solid to an everyday object, but its solids are sphere, cube, cylinder and box; the cone is not in its pair list (the library cone picture is a cut-off cone). The bottom half (color twelve solids by a four-name code) does not exist: K-265 codes flat shapes only. Not small: a cone pair and a solids color-code mode.
G2-243.note: the cone is missing from the solids

G1-444.title: Two kinds together: put-together stories
G1-444.differs: G1-444 level 1 (addsub-more, mode sentence) shows two groups to put together and the child writes all three numbers, but there is no story, totals stop at 6, and nothing is colored. The story bank (G1-238) has only "some more come" stories; no story of two kinds with nothing moving. Not small: new put-together story frames, a row of ten outlines to color, and the equation frame.
G1-444.note: put-together stories are missing from the story bank

G1-213.title: What happened in the middle?
G1-213.differs: G1-213 level 3 has exactly these stories (change unknown, "gets some more / gives some away", within 20; G1-240 level 3 within 10), two or three a page, with a picture of the known part and ONE answer box. Missing: the start-change-end strip with the sign to circle, the drawing space, and the equation frame with the box in the middle (8 + _ = 13). Medium change to the story page (strip and equation frame).
G1-213.note: a line for the equation with a box for the unknown under each story

G1-213.title: Vad hände? Räknehändelser där något saknas
G1-213.differs: Level 3 of G1-213 / G1-240 has change-unknown stories (7 + ? = 12, the picture shows only the known part) and the child writes the missing number; G1-215 has the bare open sentences to 20. Missing: start-unknown stories, the three panels foerst / sedan / nu with one covered, and writing the open sentence oneself. Small to medium change in lib/word-problems-levelset.js.
G1-213.note: händelser där starten saknas finns inte i berättelsebanken

G1-220.title: Think addition to subtract, and start the daily facts
G1-220.differs: Page 1: G1-220 level 3 (fact family houses, two one-digit parts that cross ten, so wholes 11-18) asks for the four facts of a family, but as a house with all three numbers given, not a triangle with one part missing; G1-441 has the triangles only as cut-out cards. Page 2: G1-442 level 3 is a full page of 60 mixed facts within 20, not five daily strips of ten with a "knew right away" box. Small change to each.
G1-220.note: fact triangles with one part missing; today the house gives all three numbers

G2-489.title: Two-step stories
G2-489.differs: G2-489 is this page: two-step add-and-subtract stories with "Step 1 / Step 2" number sentences. Range differs: within 20 when the steps are printed (levels 1-2) and within 50 with one answer box (level 3); the need is two-digit numbers within 100, five stories, a helper question on the first two, an answer line with a label. Small to medium change (max 100 with steps; the engine caps counted things at 20).
G2-489.note: two-step stories with two-digit numbers within 100

G2-489.unit: Story Problems with All Four Operations
G2-489.title: Two-step stories: add and subtract
G2-489.differs: G2-489 has the story kind (two changes, add and subtract, a number sentence for each step) but within 20, or within 50 with one answer box; the need is three-digit numbers within 1,000 and an empty bar model for each step. Not small: the engine caps numbers at small counts of things, and bar models are not on the story page.
G2-489.note: two-step stories with three-digit numbers within 1,000

G3-313.unit: Equal Groups, Shapes, and Equal Shares
G3-313.title: Rows and columns of squares
G3-313.differs: G3-313 (array-tasks, mode area-grid) shows a rectangle already cut into squares and asks rows × columns = total; G2-211 the same with picture arrays. Needed: rectangles with only tick marks (or one row and one column drawn) for the child to draw the lines, then "_ rows, _ columns, _ squares" and an addition of equal rows, no multiplication sign. Not small: the drawing is the point of the standard; a new mode of array-tasks.js.
G3-313.note: the child draws the rows and columns into an empty rectangle

G3-313.title: Area of a rectangle: multiply the sides
G3-313.differs: G3-313 (array-tasks, mode area-grid) asks rows × columns = area for a rectangle, but the unit squares are drawn inside and nothing is labeled with a length or a unit. Needed: rectangles with no squares, two side lengths with units (6 ft, 4 ft), the answer in square units, and four stories with a sketch. Medium change: a "sides only" level with units; the stories are new.
G3-313.note: rectangles with side lengths and units and no squares inside

G2-476.title: Measure to the quarter inch
G2-476.differs: G2-476 (measurement-more, mode inches) draws an object on a printed inch ruler, but reads whole inches only (level 3: to the nearest inch); no half or quarter readings. G3-335 is a line plot with halves that the child only READS (counts the Xs). Needed: quarter-inch readings and an empty line plot in quarters to fill with the child's own eight lengths. Not small: a quarter-inch level and a "make the plot" mode.
G2-476.note: readings to the half and the quarter inch

G2-291.unit: Ausblick bis 100: Zehnerzahlen, Zählen in Schritten und Geld
G2-291.title: Einkaufen bis 20 Euro: bezahlen und Rückgeld
G2-291.differs: The Shopping Math family has the shelf with price tags, cards that add two prices (G2-291) and change cards (G2-293), but German prices are in cents (10 to 45 ct, totals up to 99 ct) and are paid with cent coins; data/money/currencies.js has no 1-euro and 2-euro coins for de and the shop uses no notes. Needed: whole-euro prices up to 12 euros, euro coins and 5- and 10-euro notes, change from 10 or 20 euros. Medium change (currency data + a whole-euro price mode in the G2-276 generator).
G2-291.note: Preise in ganzen Euro mit Scheinen; die deutschen Münzdaten haben nur Cent

G1-438.title: Halbschriftlich addieren: den Rechenweg aufschreiben und erklären
G1-438.differs: G1-438 level 3 puts sums within 1000 on an empty Rechenstrich for the child to draw the jumps, but the second number is only two-digit (348 + 26), plus and minus are mixed, there are 4 cards, and it has no lines for the step equations or for the two-sentence explanation. A three-digit plus three-digit kind with step lines is a small to medium change in number-line-more.js mode open.
G1-438.note: dreistellig plus dreistellig mit Zeilen für die Rechenschritte

G1-447.title: Überschlag und Probe: Kann das stimmen?
G1-447.differs: G1-447 is a page already worked on which the child marks the wrong answers and writes the right ones (level 3 includes the forgotten carry), but its sums are horizontal and within 100, not written column calculations to 1000, and it has no Ueberschlag, no boxes "kann stimmen / kann nicht stimmen" and no Probe with the Umkehraufgabe. Medium change: an errors level built on column-arithmetic.js with estimate and check fields.
G1-447.note: fertige schriftliche Rechnungen bis 1000 prüfen; heute waagerecht bis 100

K-546.title: Lägesord: framför, bakom, mellan och bredvid
K-546.differs: K-546 (read the sentence, draw the picture in the right place) and K-547 (write the missing position word from a word box) are these two tasks, with Swedish sentences from the grammar engine. But the relations are in, on, above, under, next to, between, behind, in front of: "till vaenster om" and "till hoeger om" are not included, and the landmark is one shape per row, not a shelf or classroom scene. Adding left / right to position-scenes.js is a small to medium change.
K-546.note: lägesorden framför, bakom, mellan och bredvid; i dag andra lägesord

G2-293.title: Betala med sedlar och få växel tillbaka
G2-293.differs: G2-293 has a shelf with prices in kronor and change cards, but the prices are 4 to 18 kr and are paid with coins (totals up to 50 kr). Needed: prices 12 to 95 kr paid with a 20-, 50- or 100-kronor note, counting up on an empty line and drawing the change. The Swedish notes exist in the data and in G3-474 (count notes and coins). Medium change in the shopping generator G2-276.
G2-293.note: priser 12 till 95 kr som betalas med sedel; i dag mynt upp till 50 kr

G2-261.title: Kilogram: väga och jämföra
G2-261.differs: G2-261 is the balance task (an object against printed weights, the child writes the mass), but in grams with a weight box of 50 to 500 g: there are no 1-kg weights, no kitchen scale with a pointer and no ring for more or less than 1 kg. A kilogram option in the balance of G2-252 is a small to medium change; the dial scale is new artwork.
G2-261.note: hela kilogram med 1-kilosvikter; i dag gram

G3-344.title: Hur lång tid tar det?
G3-344.differs: G3-344 shows a start clock and an end clock and the child writes the hours passed, but start and end always share their minutes, so only whole hours come out (never nine to half past eleven). G3-475 level 2 has half-hour durations, but on a time line, not on two clock faces. Also missing: ringing sekunder / minuter / timmar for everyday activities. Half-hour durations are a small knob in clock-tasks.js mode elapsed; the unit part is new.
G3-344.note: tider som inte är hela timmar (från nio till halv tolv)

G1-481.title: Egen undersökning: från fråga till diagram
G1-481.differs: G1-481 is a class survey page: a tally line per choice and an empty bar graph to colour. But the question and the choices are printed (pictures of a theme), one box stands for one answer, and there are no lines for conclusions. The page needs the child's own question and choices, a frequency table with tally and number, a bar chart where the child writes title, axes and a scale of 2 per step, and three lines for conclusions. Medium change: a blank-investigation level of graph-tasks.js mode survey.
G1-481.note: egen fråga och egna svarsalternativ; i dag är de tryckta

D.title: Find the missing part
D.differs: G1-448 level 1 (addsub-more, mode bar) draws the part-part-whole bar within 20 with one part missing, but with the numbers already in it and no story, no equation frame, no answer line. The story pages (G1-213 family) have no put-together story with a missing part, show pictures, and ask one answer box. Not small: stories of a new kind plus a bar to label plus the equation frame with a box.
D.note: a put-together story with a bar model and an equation frame (the bar page has no story)

D.title: Stories with three numbers
D.differs: G1-445 (addsub-more, mode three) has the same sums: three numbers 1-9, total up to 20, a pair that makes ten to find. But it is twelve bare equations: no story, no drawing box, no frame _ + _ + _ = _ to fill from a story. The story bank has no story with three groups. Not small: new three-group story frames and a story layout.
D.note: stories with three addends (the story bank has none; the bare sums exist)

D.title: Add two two-digit numbers and make a new ten
D.differs: G2-203 draws two two-digit numbers as blocks but NEVER makes a new ten (its own check forbids it), and the blocks are printed, where the need gives an empty tens-and-ones mat for the child to draw sticks and dots, ring ten dots, and fill "_ tens and _ ones = _". G3-359 level 1 has the same sums (carry, up to 99) as a written column sum, a later method. Not small: a drawing-mat mode with regrouping.
D.note: adding with a new ten on a tens-and-ones mat (the block page never regroups)

D.title: No gaps, no overlaps
D.differs: Must be built: pictures of unit rows laid right and wrong (gap, overlap, wrong start) to judge, plus squares to cut out and glue under four objects. G1-480 and G1-139 only count units that are already laid correctly; it could be a new "find the mistake" mode of measurement-more.js (mode clips).

D.title: Subtract and open a ten
D.differs: G2-205 draws the first number as blocks, but also the second, and NEVER needs a ten opened; G3-360 has the right subtractions (two-digit, borrowing) but as a column problem with no picture. Needed: a mat with the first number drawn, the question "Enough ones? yes / no", crossing out after opening a stick. Not small: a base-ten mode with regrouping and the yes/no line.
D.note: subtracting with a ten opened, on a mat

D.title: Add three and four two-digit numbers
D.differs: Must be built: column sums of three and four two-digit numbers with a box for the new tens, plus two stories. The column factory (column-arithmetic.js, G2-255 / G3-359) writes two numbers only; it could get an "addends" option.

D.title: One-step stories with a bar model
D.differs: G1-448 level 2 draws bar models within 100 with a part or the whole missing, but filled in and with no story; its numbers are tens-based. The story pages (G1-213 family, level 3) have result-unknown and change-unknown stories only within 20, with pictures and one answer box. Not small: two-digit stories, an empty bar to label, and the equation frame with a box.
D.note: one-step stories within 100 with a bar model and an equation

D.title: What was there at the start?
D.differs: Must be built: stories with the start missing (_ + 17 = 45, _ − 25 = 38), a bar model to label and two equation lines. The story bank has no start-unknown stories; it could be a new story kind of the word-problem engine (G1-213, lib/word-problems-levelset.js) with the bar of addsub-more.js.

D.title: Compare stories: more and fewer
D.differs: G1-511 has compare stories, but only "how many more / fewer" (the difference), only within 20, and with two rows of pictures. Needed: two-digit numbers, stories that ask for the larger or the smaller amount ("15 fewer than"), two empty bars with a bracket, an equation with a box. G1-448 level 3 draws two compare bars within 20 with no story. Not small: two new story kinds and a bar layout.
D.note: compare stories within 100 with the larger or the smaller amount unknown

D.title: Same length, two units
D.differs: Must be built: a recording page for real things (six rows "about _ inches / about _ centimeters"), three sentences, and two pictures of one ribbon under a row of long and a row of short units. G2-476 and G2-235 read a printed ruler; the two-unit ribbon picture could be a mode of measurement-tasks.js (cubes-measure).

D.title: Length story problems
D.differs: Must be built: story problems about lengths within 100 (put together, take away, compare) with drawing space, an equation with a box and an answer line with the unit. The story bank has no length stories and no two-digit stories; a new story kind of the word-problem engine (G1-213).

D.unit: Bar Graphs, Picture Graphs, and Line Plots
D.title: Measure and make a line plot
D.differs: Must be built: a recording page with an empty ten-row table (object, length), an unnumbered line with twelve ticks for the child to number, room for the Xs, and three questions. G2-240 only reads a finished line plot; this could be a "make" mode of graph-tasks.js (lineplot).

D.title: Multiply by tens
D.differs: Must be built: ten-rods in equal groups with 4 × 6 tens = _ tens = _, pairs of a fact and its tens partner (3 × 7, 3 × 70), two stories. Nothing multiplies by multiples of ten; a new mode of md-more.js that uses the rod picture of base-ten-tasks.js.

D.unit: Story Problems with All Four Operations
D.title: Two-step stories: multiply or divide first
D.differs: Must be built: two-step stories with one multiplying or dividing step and one adding or subtracting step, drawing space and two equation lines. Only one-step multiplication and division stories exist (G3-370 to G3-376) and two-step stories with + and − (G2-489); new story frames for data/word-problems/two-step-frames.js.

D.unit: Story Problems with All Four Operations
D.title: A letter for the unknown, and does the answer make sense?
D.differs: Must be built: two-step stories with the three lines "My equation (with a letter) / My estimate / My answer", a yes-no check and a wrong worked answer to fix. G3-389 does only the bare step "round both numbers, then add"; no story page has an equation with a letter.

D.title: Area of an L-shape
D.differs: Must be built: L-shapes on a grid (with and without the cut line, then side lengths only) to split into two rectangles and add the two products. All area pages use plain rectangles (G3-313, G3-338, G3-477); a new mode of array-tasks.js (area-grid) or geometry-more.js.

D.title: Find the missing side
D.differs: Must be built: polygons with all side lengths but one and the perimeter given, an equation with a letter, and three stories. G3-337 only counts unit edges around a grid rectangle; a new mode of geometry-tasks.js (perimeter).

D.title: Whole numbers as fractions
D.differs: Must be built: wholes as fractions (4/4 = 1, 4/2 = 2, 3 = 3/1) from fully shaded shapes, on number lines 0-3 and as equations. G2-409 level 3 touches only d/d = 1 and G3-406 level 3 marks fractions past 1 on a 0-2 line; a new mode of fr-more.js or number-line-more.js (fraction).

D.unit: Plus und Minus bis 10: dazutun und wegnehmen
D.title: Rechnen mit der Null
D.differs: Picture stories and practice with zero (5 + 0, 5 - 0, 5 - 5) must be built: every existing addition and subtraction generator deliberately leaves 0 out (the no-zero rule written into addsub-more.js; G1-208 uses numbers from 1 or 2 up). Could be a new mode of picture-equation.js (all crossed out / nothing added) plus a zero knob in the G1-208 mental-math generator; it needs a ruling on the no-zero rule first.

D.unit: Plus und Minus bis 20 mit Zehnerübergang
D.title: Rechenwege vergleichen: Wie rechnest du 7 + 8?
D.differs: A page that shows three children with their Rechenwege for 7 + 8 (to the ten, doubling, Tauschaufgabe), has the child match new tasks to a fitting way and write its own way must be built; nothing compares strategies. Building blocks exist in number-line-more.js (bridge) and doubles-more.js (near).

D.title: Mit Handspanne, Fuß und Schritt messen
D.differs: A recording table for the child's own measuring (thing, measured with hand span / foot / step, estimated, measured, compare with a partner) must be built; no existing type is a measure-and-record sheet. Could be a new mode of measurement-more.js.

D.unit: Plus und Minus bis 100: Einer, Zehner und Zehnerübergang
D.title: Zum Zehner ergänzen, vom Zehner abziehen
D.differs: Completing to the next ten and taking a one-digit number from a tens number (36 + _ = 40, 50 - 7 = _) with the helper task in verliebte Zahlen beside it is generated nowhere: G1-446 excludes sums that land on a ten and minuends that are tens, G1-440 is bonds of 100 only. A new kind of addsub-more.js mode mental100 with a helper line (or of number-line-more.js).

D.unit: Plus und Minus bis 100: zweistellige Zahlen, Rechenwege und Sachaufgaben
D.title: Rechenwege vergleichen: schrittweise oder mit Hilfsaufgabe?
D.differs: A page that shows three children's Rechenwege for 39 + 25 (step by step, tens and ones apart, helper task), a fourth with a mistake to find, and tasks to solve with the helper task must be built; no existing type compares or checks calculation strategies.

D.unit: Plus und Minus bis 100: zweistellige Zahlen, Rechenwege und Sachaufgaben
D.title: Sachaufgaben bis 100: Frage, Rechnung, Antwort
D.differs: Word problems to 100 with the three lines Frage, Rechnung, Antwort, a superfluous number to cross out and a missing question to write do not exist: the G1-213 family stops at 20 and asks only for the answer, G2-489 is two-step to 50. A new mode on lib/word-problems-levelset.js (the native story bank is there).

D.unit: Längen und Geld: messen, schätzen, einkaufen
D.title: Meter und Zentimeter: erst schätzen, dann messen
D.differs: An estimate-then-measure table in m and cm plus sorting pictures to "kuerzer als 1 m / etwa 1 m / laenger als 1 m" must be built; G2-477 only asks which unit (cm or m) fits a thing. A new mode of measurement-more.js (recording table).

D.title: Sicher, möglich, unmöglich
D.differs: Bags of coloured balls with statements to rate sicher / moeglich / unmoeglich, drawing a bag for a sentence, and dice statements must be built: no probability type exists at all. A new factory, shared with de-3-142, sv-2-192 and sv-3-202.

D.title: Rechnen mit Hunderter- und Zehnerzahlen
D.differs: Pairs small task / big task with hundreds and tens up to 1000 (3 + 4 and 300 + 400, 54 - 3 and 540 - 30, 380 + 50, completing to the next hundred and to 1000) are generated nowhere; the mental-math pages stop at 100. A new kind of addsub-more.js mode mental100 (analogy pairs), which the Klasse 1 and 2 pair pages could share.

D.title: Halbschriftlich subtrahieren: abziehen oder ergänzen?
D.differs: G1-438 level 3 has minus tasks within 1000 on an empty Rechenstrich, but only three-digit minus two-digit, mixed with plus, with no pairs of close numbers (503 - 497), no boxes "Ich ziehe ab / Ich ergaenze" and no comparison of both ways. That choice is the point of the lesson, so this is a new kind of number-line-more.js mode open rather than an option (medium).
D.note: abziehen oder ergänzen: nahe Zahlen (503 − 497) und die Wahl des Weges

D.unit: Malnehmen und Teilen: vom Einmaleins zum halbschriftlichen Rechnen
D.title: Einmaleins mit Zehnerzahlen: 3 · 40 und 240 : 6
D.differs: Pairs 3 mal 4 and 3 mal 40, 24 : 6 and 240 : 6 with pictures of groups of ten-rods must be built; the times-table and division pages stay inside 10 x 10. A new mode of the times-table generator (G3-358) or of md-more.js.

D.unit: Malnehmen und Teilen: vom Einmaleins zum halbschriftlichen Rechnen
D.title: Halbschriftlich multiplizieren: 4 · 37
D.differs: A rectangle split at the tens line, an empty Malkreuz and three step lines for 4 mal 37 must be built; G3-313 only counts the squares of a small rectangle. A new mode, for example of array-tasks.js (area-grid, split).

D.unit: Malnehmen und Teilen: vom Einmaleins zum halbschriftlichen Rechnen
D.title: Halbschriftlich dividieren: 84 : 4
D.differs: Halbschriftliches Dividieren by splitting the number (84 = 80 + 4) with block pictures and step lines must be built; the division pages here are table facts and remainders only. New type.

D.unit: Längen und Geld: Millimeter, Kilometer und Kommaschreibweise
D.title: Millimeter: genau messen und zeichnen
D.differs: Measuring lines and real-size objects to the millimetre, writing 4 cm 7 mm = 47 mm, and drawing lines of a given length must be built: G2-235 reads whole centimetres on a drawn ruler that is not real size. A real-size mode with millimetres is needed; the millimetre ruler artwork exists in measurement-more.js mode rulers (G2-475 level 3).

D.unit: Längen und Geld: Millimeter, Kilometer und Kommaschreibweise
D.title: Meter und Kilometer: Wie weit ist ein Kilometer?
D.differs: A town map with distances in metres, sums up to 1000 m, completing to 1 km and matching everyday distances to "etwa 100 m / etwa 1 km / viele Kilometer" must be built; nothing works with metres and kilometres.

D.unit: Längen und Geld: Millimeter, Kilometer und Kommaschreibweise
D.title: Mit Komma schreiben: Euro und Cent, Meter und Zentimeter
D.differs: Writing amounts of money and lengths in three notations (3 Euro 50 ct, 350 ct, 3,50 Euro; 1 m 25 cm, 125 cm, 1,25 m) and converting must be built. G3-474 only has the child write the total of notes and coins once in the country's format; its pictures and lib/money-format.js could be reused in a new mode of money-more.js.

D.unit: Längen und Geld: Millimeter, Kilometer und Kommaschreibweise
D.title: Überschlagen beim Einkaufen: Reicht das Geld?
D.differs: Rounding comma prices to whole euros, writing the Ueberschlag and deciding whether a 10- or 20-euro note is enough must be built: G3-389 rounds two-digit numbers to tens and adds them, G2-294 compares coins with a cent price without estimating. A new mode, for example of the rounding generator G2-346 (estimate) with money.

D.title: Preistabellen: je mehr, desto teurer
D.differs: Price tables (Anzahl and Preis) to continue up to 10 with the sentence "Fuer jede Brezel mehr kommen _ Euro dazu" and finding the price of one must be built. The nearest relative is G3-328 (number machines: a printed rule applied to inputs), which could get a ratio-table mode; shared with de-3-138 and sv-3-201.

D.title: Sachaufgaben mit Tabellen lösen
D.differs: Word problems about amount and price solved in an empty two-row table with an arrow (mal 2, : 2, : 3) and an answer sentence must be built; no type has ratio tables. Same new ratio-table mode as de-3-137.

D.unit: Rechte Winkel, Vierecke, Kreise, Diagramme und Zufall
D.title: Mit dem Zirkel zeichnen: Kreise und Kreismuster
D.differs: A compass page (centres with a given radius, a target of three circles, a seven-circle flower to finish) must be built; nothing here is a drawing-instrument page.
