D.unit: Rechte Winkel, Vierecke, Kreise, Diagramme und Zufall
D.title: Diagramme genau lesen: Was stimmt, was nicht?
D.differs: Two bar charts of the same data with different scales and statements to rate stimmt / stimmt nicht / kann man nicht ablesen must be built; graph-tasks.js only reads bars (G3-332 with a scale of 5) and answers number questions (G2-237). A new mode of graph-tasks.js.

D.unit: Rechte Winkel, Vierecke, Kreise, Diagramme und Zufall
D.title: Alle Möglichkeiten finden: Tabelle und Baumdiagramm
D.differs: Combination tasks (3 T-shirts and 2 trousers, 2 of 4 ice-cream flavours, 3 children in a row) with a started table, list and tree diagram must be built; no combinatorics type exists.

D.unit: Rechte Winkel, Vierecke, Kreise, Diagramme und Zufall
D.title: Wahrscheinlicher oder unwahrscheinlicher? Versuche mit dem Zufallsbeutel
D.differs: Pairs of bags with 10 red and blue balls to compare (where is red more likely), the sentence frame and a tally list for 20 draws must be built; no probability type exists. Same new factory as de-2-123.

D.unit: Mäta och jämföra: längd, vikt och volym
D.title: Vad rymmer mest?
D.differs: Pairs of containers to ring the one that holds most, three containers to number from least to most, and drawing the number of mugs must be built: no capacity comparison exists (K-038 does the same for heavier / lighter from a real-life rank table). A new mode of measurement-tasks.js next to heavier.

D.unit: Lägga till, ta bort och lösa problem
D.title: Lös problemet: lägg, rita och berätta
D.differs: One read-aloud problem per page with a picture, a large empty box to draw the solution and a place for the answer digit must be built; the word-problem pages (G1-213) print the story with its picture strip and an answer box only. A simple new frame in the word-problem family.

D.title: Olika enheter ger olika tal
D.differs: The same object measured twice, against a row of big blocks and against a row of small paper clips, with both numbers written and the unit that needed more ringed, must be built: G1-139 (unit squares) and G1-480 (paper clips) each measure with one unit only. A new mode that puts both rows under one object in measurement-tasks.js / measurement-more.js (small to medium).

D.title: Subtraktion som skillnad: räkna upp
D.differs: Two numbers marked on a 0 to 20 line with an arc between them, where the child writes the length of the jump, the subtraction and the matching addition, must be built: G1-119 hops back to take away and G1-438 / G1-439 are take-away jumps too. A new difference mode of number-line-tasks.js.

D.title: Hitta på en egen fråga
D.differs: A picture with numbers and no question, lines for two own questions, then a calculation and an answer must be built: G1-513 is the reverse (a number sentence is given and the child writes a story). A new mode next to G1-513.

D.title: Räknehändelser 0–100: välj räknesätt
D.differs: Six stories with two-digit numbers of three kinds (change, compare, part-whole), where the child rings + or -, writes the calculation with mellanled and an answer with unit, two of them with a number that is not needed, must be built: G1-512 chooses a number sentence for stories within 20 and G2-489 is two-step to 50. A new mode on lib/word-problems-levelset.js.

D.title: Meter och centimeter
D.differs: G2-477 level 1 is the bottom part (ring cm or m for a pictured thing). The main part, a table to write an estimate and the measured value for six classroom things, does not exist; it is a plain recording table (a new, small mode of measurement-more.js).
D.note: tabell för uppskattning och uppmätt värde (meter och centimeter)

D.title: Hitta felet i programmet
D.differs: Six grids, each with an arrow program that contains exactly one wrong arrow to find and correct, must be built; nothing asks the child to debug a route. A new mode on the route engine of G1-528 / G1-529 (Maps and Coordinates maker).

D.title: Slump: vad finns i påsen?
D.differs: Bags of 10 balls in two colours with statements to rate omoejligt / moejligt / saekert, naming the most likely colour, and a tally table for 20 own draws must be built; no probability type exists. Same new factory as de-2-123.

D.title: Talsymboler förr och nu
D.differs: A key of Egyptian number symbols and Roman numerals I, V, X with numbers to translate both ways must be built; no type has historical numerals.

D.title: Är svaret rimligt?
D.differs: Finished answers within 1000 to judge by an estimate (rimligt / orimligt, the estimate written as proof) and choosing the reasonable answer to everyday questions must be built. G1-447 has worked sums to check, but its wrong answers are off by 1, 2 or 10 within 100, which an estimate cannot catch; G3-389 rounds and adds two-digit numbers. A new mode, for example of addsub-more.js (errors with large errors) with the rounding generator.

D.title: Skriftlig huvudräkning med mellanled
D.differs: Horizontal three-digit addition and subtraction with a template for mellanled (hundratal, tiotal, ental, svar) must be built: three-digit sums exist only as column pages (uppstaellning: G2-258, G3-361) and the horizontal mental pages stop at 100 (G1-446). A new level of addsub-more.js mode mental100 with a steps template, shared with sv-2-177.

D.unit: Mätning: tid, massa, volym, temperatur och äldre mått
D.title: Äldre mått: tum, fot, aln och famn
D.differs: Pictures of tum, fot, aln and famn on the body with a table to measure with one's own body unit and then in cm and m must be built; no type is a measure-and-record sheet. A new mode of measurement-more.js, shared with the other recording tables (de-1-101, de-2-116, sv-2-181).

D.title: Proportionella samband: dubbelt så många, dubbelt så mycket
D.differs: Two-row tables of proportional relations (number of ice creams and price; a recipe for 4 recalculated for 2 and 8) with a sentence in words must be built. The nearest relative is G3-328 (number machines: a printed rule applied to inputs), which could get a ratio-table mode; shared with de-3-137 and de-3-138.

D.title: Slumpförsök: lika stor chans?
D.differs: A prediction box, a frequency table for 30 dice throws, an empty bar chart to draw and a comparison of two bags must be built; no probability type exists (G1-481 has an empty tally and graph for a class survey, which could lend its layout). Same new factory as de-2-123.

D.title: Mäta i halva centimeter och visa i diagram
D.differs: G3-335 (the type behind the teaching point) is a finished line plot over a number line with half steps; the child only counts the crosses above each number. The lesson has the child measure things to the nearest half centimetre and draw the crosses itself; that production page does not exist. Small to medium change: a fill-in line plot in graph-tasks.js (like bar-fill) with a list of measurements.
D.note: mäta i halva centimeter och själv göra diagrammet
